'''''Bromelia karatas''''' is a plant [[species]] in the genus ''[[Bromelia]]''. This species is [[Native plant|native]] to [[West Indies]] and to [[Latin America]] from [[San Luis Potosí]] and [[Sinaloa]] south to [[Brazil]].<ref name=j>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=222097 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Martinelli |first1=Gustavo |last2=Vieira |first2=Cláudia Magalhães |last3=Gonzalez |first3=Marcos |last4=Leitman |first4=Paula |last5=Piratininga |first5=Andréa |last6=Costa |first6=Andrea Ferreira da |last7=Forzza |first7=Rafaela Campostrini |title=Bromeliaceae da Mata Atlântica Brasileira: lista de espécies, distribuição e conservação |journal=Rodriguésia |date=January 2008 |volume=59 |issue=1 |pages=209–258 |jstor=23499386 |doi=10.1590/2175-7860200859114 |trans-title=Bromeliaceae of the brazilian Atlantic Forest: checklist, distribution and conservation |language=pt-BR|doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Espejo-Serna |first1=Adolfo |last2=López-Ferrari |first2=Ana Rosa |last3=Ramírez-morillo |first3=Ivón |last4=Holst |first4=Bruce K. |last5=Luther |first5=Harry E. |last6=Till |first6=Walter |title=Checklist of Mexican Bromeliaceae with Notes on Species Distribution and Levels of Endemism |journal=Selbyana |date=1 June 2004 |volume=25 |issue=1 |pages=33–86 |url=https://journals.flvc.org/selbyana/article/view/121512 |language=en |issn=2689-0682 |jstor=41760147 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Holst |first1=Bruce K. |title=Checklist of Venezuelan Bromeliaceae with Notes on Species Distribution by State and Levels of Endemism |journal=Selbyana |date=1 February 1994 |volume=15 |issue=1 |pages=132–149 |url=https://journals.flvc.org/selbyana/article/view/121000 |language=en |issn=2689-0682 |jstor=41759858 }}</ref>
